subject: Fire Event for Option Already Chosen

messages.author: 7b36a5521b8eb4d4
messages.subject: Fire Event for Option Already Chosen
parts: Is it possible to trigger an event for clicking on a radioButtons widget when the user clicks on a selection that is currently chosen ? In my application the user either uploads a data file using a fileInput widget or selects an already available dataset using a radioButtons widget. If they uploaded a file, then decided they want to use an existing dataset from the radio choices instead, I'd like to trigger an event, even if they click on the currently shown radio choice and proceed with loading it into the session.
